mainEntity.name: Can I convert my basement into an ADU if it has low ceiling height?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it's often possible to convert a basement with low ceiling height into an ADU, but it may require underpinning the foundation to lower the floor. This is a complex structural modification that adds significant cost and time to the project. A practical tradeoff involves evaluating if the added expense of underpinning provides a sufficient return on investment, compared to finding alternative solutions or accepting a more compact design, relevant for many older homes in Berkeley or Oakland.
